category: Data Processing Policies, Processes, and Procedures (CT.PO-P)
subcategory_text: Policies, processes, and procedures for enabling individuals’ data processing preferences and requests are established and in place.
informative_references: GDPR Art. 12-22 (Rights of the data subject), Art. 7 (Consent)
Aligned with NIST CSF 2.0 PR.AA-P3 (access requests honoured)
implementation_examples: Define processes for handling individuals' data-processing preferences and rights requests (access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability, objection, automated decision-making)
Authenticate requestors and operate the request lifecycle: receive, validate, fulfil, communicate
Meet legal response deadlines (e.g., one month under GDPR Art. 12(3))
assessment_objectives: Determine whether a defined process exists for handling individual preferences and rights requests
Determine whether request authentication uses a proportionate method
Determine whether the lifecycle (receive, validate, fulfil, communicate) is instrumented
Determine whether legal timeframes are met
